integrity: The universal formulas are proved analytically from closed neighborhoods, maximum-spanning-tree weights, and an exact count of non-dominating sets. Exhaustive computation through order 11 is used only as a finite stress test.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to finite complete multipartite graphs and k at least 1. It exactly measures the residual of the pairwise spanning-tree correction but does not provide a general higher-order correction construction for arbitrary graphs. An equivalent formulation under terminology absent from the inspected sources remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact residual of the spanning-tree overlap bound on complete multipartite graphs
